name: 地域と検索の設定をまとめたクイック設定シート
prompt:
Input roles: Image 1: authoritative full Japanese mock: exact frame, spacing, close control and icons. Image 2: magnified mock top card: exact field and label inset. Image 3: magnified mock lower card: exact compact selector and safe-search row. Image 4: edit target: preserve v006 Japanese copy and clear green styling; geometry is not authoritative.
Image 1 is the authoritative Japanese mock. Reproduce its visible layout, not a redesign. Images 2 and 3 are 2x crops that clarify the exact insets and compact selector. Image 4 is only a style/text reference; do not copy its shifted geometry or substituted theme controls.
Create the same 366x588 settings sheet as Image 1. Preserve its pale gray outer background, white cards, all exact Japanese copy, icon drawings, button, separators, rounded corners, and top-right X. Do not omit the X or replace any icon with a different conventional symbol. Do not add a phone shell.
Use these exact positions at 366x588: header x16,y30; close X at top right x342,y32; first category x16,y80; first card x16,y106,w334,h240; first field x28,y178,w322,h40; second field x28,y294,w322,h40; second category x16,y364; second card x16,y390,w334,h129; bottom action x16,y532,w334,h40. Keep the inner theme control compact and exactly as in Image 3; preserve its three mock glyphs. Match labels and symbols to Image 1 instead of moving text farther right.
Image 4 is missing the X, expands and shifts the cards, and invents sun/moon/shield/globe icons. Correct all of those differences by matching Image 1 pixel layout. Keep the mock readable and balanced: no added whitespace or oversized controls, and do not compress any row below the mock dimensions.
